newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ C 195 of June 25, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ C 195 of June 25, 1997.

text.p: COUNCIL ACT of 26 May 1997 drawing up, on the basis of Article K.3 (2) (c) of the Treaty on European Union, the Convention on the fight against corruption involving officials of the European Communities or officials of Member States of the European Union (97/C 195/01) END OF DOCUMENT.
